title: 'Model' Allegedly Kills Two People in Deadly Crash Fueled by Pink Cocaine
description:
Bodycam footage shows the aftermath of a deadly crash involving a self-proclaimed Instagram model in August 2024. Maecee Lathers, 24, is accused of causing the deaths of two people in the deadly crash. She was arrested and charged with DUI manslaughter. At one point, Lathers told police she was "from the future." Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
